reviews.title: A good deal.
reviews.comment: It says it was renewed, but you can't prove it by me, it looked brand new.  I originally bought this motherboard from Walmart.  it was $40 more, but was listed as new.  Walmart shipped it from New Egg and when it came, it wasn't new, and it didn't work.  This renewed board was cheaper and in way better shape than Walmart's supposedly new one.  Put in a 14600k and works perfectly.
reviews.author: Roy C. Ramsey

reviews.title: Waste of Money
reviews.comment:
Arrived missing pieces. "Replacement" parts were included, but there is no way to physically install the replacements as they DO NOT GO TO THIS MOTHERBOARD. So, pretty useless.
Waste of money, waste of time, I should have paid the extra $20 and purchased new.
reviews.author: Shadow Gray

reviews.title: A great foundation for an extremely fast computer.!
reviews.comment: This motherboard works awesome!  I would give it 5 stars but I purchased a used in box one to save a little.  My box came without the antenna for the internal wifi.  This isn't a major problem and those antennas are available for about $20.  Still I'd prefer not to have to find my own work around.  I could have sent it back but I had limited time to get my computer working and I needed the computer working asap.  I already had something else to allow the computer to connect so it wasn't a big problem.
reviews.author: JustDeming

reviews.comment: La primera que compré no me salió bueno de hecho llegó y no funcionaba pero la segunda que me mandaron perfecto
